game.name: OneShot World Machine Edition
game.desc: A puzzle adventure about Niko, a child who wakes in a dying world holding a lightbulb that is meant to become its new sun. The game knows you are there, and treats you as someone separate from Niko. It talks to you, remembers you, and eventually asks you to decide what a world gets to do with its only chance. World Machine Edition rebuilds the original's habit of reaching outside its own window into a simulated desktop you explore between chapters, so none of it touches your real machine. Soft pixel art, a quiet score, and an ending that plays once.
